text:
ashley: seeing apiserver 503s across eu-west1 starting ~10:12 UTC. controller-manager queue spiking, leader-election frequency increased. etcd follower lag jumping from ~20ms -> 1s. noticed a big GPU onboarding wave at the same time. anyone seeing correlating signals?
maria: :eyes: pulling etcd and node IO graphs now. early signs of WAL latency and some NVMe write stalls on the three etcd hosts. also seeing NAT conntrack close to capacity on the eu-west1 edge proxies.
ops-bot: ALERT: apiserver_5xx_rate eu-west1 increased to 3.4% at 10:12:34 UTC (auto-detected anomaly)
sam: confirmed conntrack saturation. large provision batch opened many egress connections to artifact/registry and telemetry endpoints -> SNAT port exhaustion -> proxy half-open sockets -> apiserver client timeouts and fd pressure.
leo: can we pause the onboarding wave? that should free SNAT ports quickly. tagging @infra for immediate action.
ashley: paused the onboarding queue for eu-west1 (`./provisioner pause --region eu-west1`) — done. also scaled down concurrent batch size to 10. apiserver 503s still present but trending down.
maria: after pausing, conntrack counts dropped and a couple of etcd hosts' NVMe write latency fell back. controller-manager backlog is draining slowly; still seeing leader-election retries but not every 30s anymore. recommendation: temporarily bump controlplane file descriptors and give etcd some IO headroom. e.g. `sysctl -w fs.file-max=200000` on controlplane VMs and limit non-critical background IO.
sam: also enabling NAT ephemeral port reuse and rolling proxy pool B to handle transient egress spikes. starting rolling update now (3 instances at a time).
ops-bot: NOTE: rollout started for nat-proxy-eu-west1 (group-B) at 10:18 UTC
leo: after the first proxy batch, etcd follower lag reduced to ~120ms and apiserver 5xx rate down to 0.6%. controller-manager workqueue length decreasing.
ashley: good progress. next steps: 1) implement onboarding rate limiting to prevent single-window blasts, 2) add SNAT headroom to eu-west1 infra, 3) add a probe to fail fast on proxy port exhaustion so we surface earlier. i'll own a short follow-up doc.
maria: filing RCA ticket: https://redwood/internal/issue/INC-20260312-041 (brief notes + timeline). recommend a post-mortem with infra and provisioning teams to adjust batch defaults.
sam: +1 — will add a quick mitigations playbook to provisioning runbook (reduce concurrency, stagger by AZ, backoff on SNAT warnings).
ashley: leaving thread open for 30m monitoring. ping here if any regression. :thumbsup:
